title: Templars as keepers of advanced knowledge and a bloodline of Christ
summary: Randall Carlson tells of Templars as keepers of advanced knowledge and a bloodline of Christ, about c. 1307 (Jacques de Molay) at France, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.
